target: Expected observed S-NPP daily centroid cell-days; never synthetic detection locations
cohort: Explicit exact standard-product pair, verified complete UTC dates without processing gaps
prediction_inputs: sin and cos of UTC day of year

interval.method: absolute log1p calibration residuals, same as monthly; no guaranteed dependent coverage

gates.authority: proposed project gates requiring human scientific approval before fitting

dependency: statsmodels==0.15.0 optional research extra; missing dependency or failed fit leaves estimates unavailable
amendment: New protocol ID and human approval required for any method or threshold amendment.

method_annex.ratio_fit: annual=sum(reference)/sum(MODIS); zero denominator unavailable. Month-specific ratio requires monthly MODIS denominator >=30; otherwise use annual ratio.
method_annex.selection: Fixed identity, annual/month-specific ratio and hurdle candidates evaluated on identical chronological dates; hurdle must beat all baselines under frozen gates; no selection using test outcomes.
method_annex.metrics: WAPE=sum(abs(error))/sum(reference); signed relative bias=sum(error)/sum(reference), undefined if denominatorzero. Interval score width+20*miss distance for nominal90%. Log error uses log((prediction+1)/(reference+1)).
method_annex.intervals: Sorted absolute log1p calibration residual, rankceil((n+1)*0.9); require rank<=n. expm1(log1p(point)±radius), lower clippedzero; zero radius preserves exact point; nonzero boundaries rounded outward by nextafter.
method_annex.qualification: All declared project gates apply to both monthly selection strategies; no post-test candidate choice. Synthetic input cannot enter authentic admission. Previously inspected periods are retrospective. Human conclusion/native/task-study gates remain separate.
method_annex.hurdle: statsmodels0.15.0 HurdleCountModel(dist=poisson,zerodist=poisson); intercept explicit; BFGS,maxiter200, library defaults otherwise. Both zero and positive training outcomes/full-rank design required. Convergence, Hessian and numerical warnings fail closed. predictmean and1-predictprobzero. Runtime numerical package versions recorded.
method_annex.zero_subset: At least30 MODIS-zero/VIIRS-positive testdates; >=10% log-error improvement over every baseline on that subset. At least3supported testyears; no season WAPE >10%worse than any baseline. This does not establish seasonal/zero-subset interval coverage.
method_annex.opportunity: No opportunity denominator inferred. Supported native observation-opportunity subset evaluation remains unavailable until qualified geometry evidence exists.
method_annex.subgroup_interval_reporting: Report exact covered_count and interval_count per test year and season; pooled85%floor is not proof of90%temporal/seasonal/conditional coverage. Calibration requires all four calendar quarters. Zero/small-count support remains explicit.

execution_modes.human_reviewed: Signed independent protocol approval before authentic qualification evaluation.
execution_modes.ai_experimental: Explicit user-authorized exploration under ai-exploration-v1; no human approval or scientific qualification. Synthetic inputs cannot enter this mode.
